the detectability of a signal is improved by adding additional frequency components to the basic signal, and the improvement is greater for more complex signals than for less complex ones.
the addition of a second component to a basic auditory stimulus significantly improved the detectability of the auditory stimulus.
complex auditory signals are more detectable than pure tones and the number of components of the signal is directly related to the detection ability of the signal.

the design and testing of auditory stimuli for use in mine detection systems.
the engineering of auditory signals to improve mine detection performance.
